title: wuyoscar/GPT-Image2-Skill
claim: wuyoscar/GPT-Image2-Skill — GPT Image 2 prompt gallery, image prompt library, agentic skill, and CLI for OpenAI image generation/editing
why_good: This project leverages AI to streamline the creative process, making it easier for non-experts to generate high-quality images.
